tests.title: Create a TUI 4-channel tracker that makes my entire compositional workflow transparent to the end-user, and speeds up my compositional process.
Must be a TUI (the web-deployed version will be a TUI inside a frame with some extra non TUI buttons)
tests.rationale: The TUI is the product; the web frame may only add non-TUI chrome around it.

tests.title: All menus and parameters must be reachable within 2 button presses
tests.rationale: The tracker must stay fast and discoverable; nothing may be buried behind long navigation.

tests.title: Must work cross-platform, both as a desktop app, and web-deployed app
tests.rationale: The same product ships as the `spt` desktop binary and as a static client-side web app built from shared code.

tests.title: Any additional packages must be checked against typosquatting and other security vulnerabilities
tests.rationale: Slopsquatting is the main supply-chain risk for an AI-assisted project.

tests.title: The web-hosted version must be a static client-side webpage. No shared terminal.
checks: must not contain node:http in src/web/**
must not contain createServer in src/web/**
must not contain setHost(nodeHost) in src/web/**
tests.rationale: multiple people need to be able to access the site and experience it individually, and we need to prevent security issues of shared access. Fate is per-visitor: no server process owns a Session, no signal crosses visitors.

tests.title: TypeScript as the language
tests.rationale: Keeps the domain, hosts and UI type-safe and testable.
